class Node:
    def __init__(self, data):
        self.data = data
        self.left = None
        self.right = None
        self.random = None

def cloneTree(root):
    if not root:
        return None
    
    # Create a mapping from original nodes to their corresponding cloned nodes
    node_map = {}
    
    # Perform a depth-first traversal to clone the tree
    def clone_node(node):
        if not node:
            return None
        
        # Check if the node is already cloned
        if node in node_map:
            return node_map[node]
        
        # Create a new node with the same data
        cloned_node = Node(node.data)
        node_map[node] = cloned_node
        
        # Recursively clone the left and right subtrees
        cloned_node.left = clone_node(node.left)
        cloned_node.right = clone_node(node.right)
        
        return cloned_node
    
    # Perform a depth-first traversal to set the random pointers in the cloned tree
    def set_random_pointers(node):
        if not node:
            return
        
        if node.random:
            node_map[node].random = node_map[node.random]
        
        set_random_pointers(node.left)
        set_random_pointers(node.right)
    
    cloned_root = clone_node(root)
    set_random_pointers(root)
    
    return 1 if cloned_root else 0
